title: Restore retention of a backed-out contact in a cleaning-robot harness
fault: Primary crimped terminal4mm backed out in three-lead MX150 reconstruction, secondary lock open; neighboring contacts initially seated.
justification: Molex explicitly lists MX150 for commercial cleaning-robot brush/vacuum-pump wiring. Contact retention repair is distinct from mating complete plugs.
objects: Unmated Molex MX150 33472 series receptacle and compatible precrimped leads at real scale
Small ordinary slotted screwdriver for captive TPA
Low-voltage continuity tester and matching connector
Two or three SimReady service-bench distractors

primary_sources.evidence: D7:5mm captive TPA travel;2.4–3.5mm screwdriver at designated pry point;straight release-tool engagement
Actual release-tool geometry and applicable contact families
33472 actual housing product drawing; exact variant selection pending
Manufacturer drawing:20.45mm terminal length,9.95mm contact-box length,2.55mm width,2.80mm body height,0.30mm copper-alloy sheet; small polarization rib3.33mm total height.

F24,mechanical requirements:terminal retention>=90N;terminal insertion<=30N;2x2receptacle TPA insertion/extraction<=90N deviation. Bounds are not measured nominal forces. No calibrated force claims yet.
1.5mm2 FLRY-B:30x0.25mm strands,2.4mm maximum insulation OD. Supports scale but does not establish bending stiffness.
Comparable1.5mm2 FLRY-B:2.4mm maxOD,16g/m approximate mass; prototype21.5g/m must be reconciled before final scene.

nearest.comparison: Ferruled wire inserted into DIN-rail push-in terminal; no removal/reseating of keyed crimp contact or captive secondary assurance lock.
Screw-terminal wire installation; reviewer requires loaded slot engagement and correct torque. This is a contact-retention repair, but must likewise avoid fake tool engagement.

valid_shortcuts: If pushing the contact directly home restores real retention, accept it. Do not require unnecessary extraction.
Allow ordinary service-tool and plier routes if they fit real access without damage.
risks: PDF initial fault cannot coexist with intact fully locked TPA unless retention is actually damaged; do not simulate impossible starting state.
No enlarged pin or added gripper handles.
Correct terminal/lance compliance and real retention force need physical validation.
Robot relevance is supported at product-family level; do not label a generic connector as a specific robot assembly.
Reduced internal lance and cavity geometry is reconstructed rather than dimensioned in the supplied simplified STEP; loads and retention must be measured before claiming fidelity.
Housing drawing G=2.75mm describes pre-stage protrusion; D7 service guide states5mm stroke. Exact selected-variant final recess must be checked, not equated with G.

90N locked retention must not be replaced with a weak latch. Manufacturer maximum insertion forces are specification bounds, not nominal measured forces. Current prototype has no calibrated secondary detents or seal resistance.
state: Engineeringprototype only. Fullrobotpress failed at2400Hz via toolslip;480Hz loaded behavior not converged. Primary/top-left frontedgecontact flex pass, bottomaccess unresolved. Bench-supporteddriverreach diagnostic running; seal/material/damage fidelity remain open.

scale_probe: tasks/recover-backed-out-robot-connector-contact/probe_wire.py:2.4mm diameter rigid70mm coupon, real pad contact; cannot validate flexible wiring or complete recovery.

mass_recheck.terminal_note: 33012-2001 right reel and33012-3001 left reel payoff, not loose-vs-reel distinction. Both0.391g.
mass_recheck.required_changes: Current prototypes use12g housing frame plus1.24g links,0.645g wire segments,1.05g root. Reconcile to sourced assembly/terminal/wire masses before final demos; verify COM and inertia. No running probe modified.
mass_recheck.prepared_probe: probe_connector_mass_idle.py and probe_connector_retention_mass_clearance.py use sourced masses; not yet run.

wire_stiffness_basis.note: Analytical independent-strand estimate at nominal110GPa copper modulus, excluding PVC and strand slip. Not a measured wire stiffness or complete calibration.

material_recheck.note: Do not label housing as PBT based on the separate cavity plug material. Exact grade/modulus and reduced-lance stiffness are not calibrated.

closing_access_gate: Prototype TPA has two outer face strips. Check real four-hole frontplate and central webs against drawing/photo before selecting a press tool. Final face recess likely prevents full closure using broad rigid finger pads; do not silently add a pad or resize geometry.

latest_component_evidence.reseat: 381-frame run left contact seated after wire release at -0.157 mm; TPA open
latest_component_evidence.retention: Corrected-mass fixture held 90 N at 2400 and 4800 Hz with 9.62 micrometre final axial difference; both use 1e-7 kg m^2 regularization
latest_component_evidence.blocked: 25 N press stops TPA at 1.041 mm with contact still 3.995 mm backed out
latest_component_evidence.press: Current tool probe confirmed runtime shared pose feedback; central TPA web geometry remains a reduced approximation

reviewer_risk_recheck.scope: Before submission, justify exact bench specimen and relevance, not only connector family use in cleaning robots.
reviewer_risk_recheck.circuit_context: Current component specimen has one service lead and three cavity plugs. It is not a demonstrated complete functioning motor harness. Do not claim restored electrical service from this component result.
reviewer_risk_recheck.required: Either describe a legitimate single-contact assembly/service specimen with defensible importance, or source and model the representative populated harness and its actual access constraints. Do not add a nominal robot label to a generic fixture.
